item.title: US Congressman says support growing for bill to stop Israeli settlements
item.description:
US Congressman says support growing for bill to stop Israeli settlements

Support keeps growing for the proposed Stop the Settlements Act, which would sanction anyone looking to take Palestinian land in the West Bank or Gaza, US Congressman Joaquin Castro has said.

"Since I introduced the bill alongside Reps. Dean, Beyer, Casar, Jacobs, and Escobar, over 50 members have now co-sponsored," Castro wrote on X.

He said settlement expansion pushes Palestinians "off their land and makes peace harder to achieve". 

"It’s time to use tools like sanctions to stop it," he said, posting the names of 10 new representatives who have supported the proposed legislation.

The Stop the Settlements Act would sanction anyone looking to take Palestinian land in the West Bank or Gaza. And support keeps growing. Since I introduced the bill alongside Reps. item.description:
Gaza health ministry says 1,501 Palestinians killed since October 2025 'ceasefire'

Israeli forces have killed a total of 1,501 Palestinians since the October 2025 “ceasefire”, Gaza's  health ministry says.

The toll includes three new deaths on Wednesday, including two Palestinians who died from injuries sustained in earlier Israeli attacks.

The ministry’s latest report said 17 people were injured in the past 24 hours, adding to the 5,323 injured since the October 2025. During the same period,  nearly 840 bodies were recovered from the debris of the devastated territory.

item.title: Purpose of Genocide Convention is to prevent genocide, Navi Pillay says
item.description:
Purpose of Genocide Convention is to prevent genocide, Navi Pillay says

Former UN high commissioner for human rights and 2026 Nobel Peace Prize laureate Navi Pillay has said that the purpose of the Genocide Convention is to prevent genocide, and countries are obliged to step in when they learn of any genocidal conflict.

In an interview with Sky News, Pillay reiterated call for prosecuting Israeli Prime Minister, president and former Israeli defence minister, either by national courts or by the International Criminal Court. 

"The purpose of the Genocide Convention is to prevent a genocide. The world doesn't want a genocide to happen and then react to it. Thousands of people get killed in these genocidal attacks. 

"Therefore, the focus of all states when they adopted the genocide convention is as soon as you hear that there might be genocidal conflict, you have to step in to prevent it. That's a legal obligation that rests on every state even if the genocide didn't happen in their own territory."

item.title: Board of Peace plan stalled as Israel blocks Gaza outpost construction, report says
item.description:
Board of Peace plan stalled as Israel blocks Gaza outpost construction, report says

Israel is not allowing the construction of a key military outpost in Gaza that is part of US President Donald Trump’s Board of Peace, the Guardian has reported.

The board issued the contract in August to Louisiana-based Arkel International, which would build a base for 150 international troops that would serve as the vanguard of an international stabilisation force (ISF), the newspaper said.

Israel has yet to permit the contract to move forward, the Guardian reported, citing a person with direct knowledge of the matter.

Contractors and trucks are not being allowed to cross into Gaza to begin the work. “Israel won’t open the border,” the source said.

The Board of Peace, formed in the wake of an October 2025 ceasefire in Gaza, is central to Trump’s claims to have ended the conflict.

The source told the Guardian that without the contract, the rest of the Board of Peace programme cannot launch.

“You can’t get in without an international stabilisation force. You can’t rebuild,” the person said, according to the Guardian.

item.title: Egypt has ‘no hidden agendas,’ ambitions against anyone: President
item.description: President Abdel Fattah al-Sisi said Wednesday that Egypt has “no hidden agendas” or ambitions against anyone, responding to remarks by an Israeli official about the Sinai Peninsula in northeastern Egypt, according to a statement by the presidency, Anadolu reports. Sisi made the remarks during the armed forces’ 44th educational symposium, titled, “Homeland of Heroes,” marking the 53rd anniversary of the October 1973 war. Responding to the Israeli remarks, Sisi said Egypt had “fought a war to defend its land and recovered all its territory.” He questioned whether some circles in Israel harbored “unjustified perceptions or fears about Egyptian ambitions against them.” “Egypt’s first and foremost goal is to preserve its security and stability and safeguard its people’s resources,” he said, […]

item.title: Indonesia slams Israel for discriminating against one of its pilots
item.description: Indonesia on Wednesday slammed Israel for discriminating against one of its nationals after Tel Aviv banned an Ethiopian Airlines aircraft from landing for having an Indonesian pilot, local media reported. Foreign Ministry spokesperson Yvonne Mewengkang said that Jakarta rejects such actions taken on the basis of “political considerations or one’s nationality,” local English daily the Jakarta Globe reported. The spokesperson said that every flight authority has the right to set the safety standards for the crew but that this must be done in an “objective, proportionate and risked-based manner.” “Israel restricts its flight crew from certain countries, including Indonesia based only on their citizenship. item.title: 4 Palestinians killed, several others injured in Israeli airstrikes in Gaza despite ceasefire
item.description: Four Palestinians were killed and several others, including a girl, were injured in Israeli airstrikes targeting the Gaza Strip on Wednesday, Anadolu reports. A medical source at Al-Shifa Hospital told Anadolu Agency that the body of Reem Asaad Awad, 33, and two injured people were brought to the hospital following the airstrike on a residential building in the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City. The source said the strike caused extensive destruction to the targeted apartment and neighboring buildings. A large fire also broke out after the attack and was later extinguished by civil defense crews. item.title: Lebanese president, top Iranian diplomat stress diplomatic solutions to regional conflicts
item.description: Lebanese President Joseph Aoun received a phone call Wednesday from Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araghchi to discuss the situation in the region amid recent developments, the Lebanese presidency said, Anadolu reports. In a statement, the presidency said both sides agreed on the need to support diplomatic solutions as the best means of ending conflicts in the region. Later, Iran’s Foreign Ministry said Araghchi stressed during the call the need to halt Israeli attacks on Lebanon and end the occupation of areas in the country’s south. Araghchi also briefed Aoun on Iran’s diplomatic efforts in recent weeks and days, while the two sides discussed expanding bilateral relations and continuing contacts and consultations between officials of the two countries, the ministry added.
